resources.string: Filters ad notifications on-device with local AI. The LSPosed module keeps the system from stopping the notification listener service.
Keep-alive helper: keeps this app bound to the system (does not read screen content).
Alerts when a new version is available.
Uncheck this app, then check it again to restore notification access
Alerts when notification access is lost (heads-up + lock screen).
Filtering paused (%1$s). Tap \"Repair now\" to resume.
Automatic repair failed repeatedly (%1$s). Restart your phone, then reopen this app.

Notification access lost (%1$s).
Filtering is paused; new notifications will not be filtered until it recovers.
• With Shizuku/Root: tap "Repair now" to force a rebind
• Others: tap "Access settings", uncheck this app, then check it again

Notification access lost (%1$s), and automatic repair failed repeatedly.
The system usually stops rebinding after the listener crashes repeatedly;
only a restart can reset that state.
· Restart your phone, then reopen this app
· If it fails again, export the diagnostic log
listener not connected; watchdog already retried
